entry.title: Every block the layout knows
entry.content:

A quotation, which should be marked down its left edge rather than silently indented.

entry.title: Entities & escapes: <not a tag>
entry.summary: Ampersands & angle brackets <like this> must survive as text, and   must not become a stray glyph. Curly quotes: “quoted”.
